checkpoints.quote: It is a thin wrapper around a client annotation rather than a build-ready story.

checkpoints.quote: Clarify scope with the client/reporter: is this a UI-only removal or a full removal of the saved-credential feature?... *(Aroha Walker / product.)*
checkpoints.reason: The analysis lists confirming with the client (Aroha Walker), adding acceptance criteria, and assigning/estimating as next steps, matching the checkpoint.
The analysis never characterizes the ticket as a bug or error; it treats it as a feature/change request throughout.
The analysis consistently treats the arrow and handwritten text as an annotation on the screenshot, not as part of the actual app interface.
